description.value:
Slot none; Price 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 1 sp

Whenever a bouncing talent targeting a single creature has no effect on its intended target (whether due to spell resistance or a successful saving throw) you may, as a swift action, redirect it to target another eligible creature within range. The redirected talent behaves in all ways as if its new target were the original target for the talent. Talents that affect a target in any way (including a lesser effect from a successful saving throw) may not be redirected in this manner.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Bouncing Spell; Cost 2,500 gp (lesser), 5,000 gp (normal), 10,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Use as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect while holding this apparatus in at least one hand. Spend one of its three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. The apparatus does not require knowing its feat or paying that feat’s extra spell points/casting time. Normal sphere-effect costs and other known metamagic costs still apply. The chosen sphere effect must be caster level 7 or lower.

The original talent must target one creature and have no effect at all. Redirect as a swift action to another eligible target within range; even a lesser effect on a successful save prevents redirection.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. The Feat Cost in the source applies to taking the feat instead of using the physical item.
